title: Titanic's Final 2 Hours and 40 Minutes
description: From the iceberg to the last moments, the timeline of the Titanic's final night.

scenes.narration: From the moment it hit the iceberg, the Titanic had two hours and forty minutes left.
scenes.image_prompt: RMS Titanic sailing at night on a flat calm black ocean, lights glowing, stars above

scenes.narration: It's April 14th, 1912. Twenty to midnight. The North Atlantic is flat calm and freezing.
scenes.image_prompt: lookout in the crow's nest of the Titanic peering into the dark freezing night, breath visible

scenes.narration: The lookout rings the bell. Iceberg, right ahead. The ship turns, but not enough.
scenes.image_prompt: huge iceberg looming in front of the Titanic bow at night, ship starting to turn

scenes.narration: The ice scrapes along the side, opening several compartments to the sea.
scenes.image_prompt: seawater rushing into a lit boiler room of the Titanic, stokers running

scenes.narration: There are lifeboats for only about half the people on board.
scenes.image_prompt: crew lowering a wooden lifeboat down the side of the tilted Titanic at night, passengers in coats

scenes.narration: The first boats leave half empty. Many passengers can't believe the ship will sink.
scenes.image_prompt: half empty lifeboat rowing away from the brightly lit Titanic tilting by the bow

scenes.narration: At 2:20 in the morning, the Titanic breaks apart and disappears.
scenes.image_prompt: the Titanic stern rising high out of the dark ocean under the stars, lights going out

scenes.narration: More than 1,500 people died. The rescue ship arrived less than two hours later. Could more have been saved? Comment below.
scenes.image_prompt: rescue ship Carpathia at dawn among icebergs picking up survivors from lifeboats
